l-m-e6-b03-25.title: Ịlele ngwọta ịtụgharị m³ ka ọ bụrụ cm³
l-m-e6-b03-25.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta ịtụgharị olu tankị mmiri, 2 m³, ka ọ bụrụ cm³, soro usoro ọrụ ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere, mezie ya.
l-m-e6-b03-25.material: Tụgharịa olu tankị mmiri 2 m³ ka ọ bụrụ cm³. Ngwọta: ① 1 m=100 cm ② 1 m³=100 cm³ ③ 2 m³=200 cm³ ④ Azịza: 200 cm³. Chọta ahịrị mbụ e mere njehie.
l-m-e6-b03-25.s.s1.r.a: Nke a ziri ezi dịka mmekọrịta nke nkeji ogologo.
l-m-e6-b03-25.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrị a jiri 2 mụbaa uru sitere na ②, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ e mere njehie.
l-m-e6-b03-25.s.s1.explain: 1 m³ bụ cube nke akụkụ ya bụ 100 cm. 100×100×100=1000000 cm³.
l-m-e6-b03-25.s.s2.model.0: A na-achọta olu site n’ịmụba ogologo, obosara na ịdị elu, ya mere ị ga-amụba 100 ugboro atọ. 1 m³=1000000 cm³, ya mere ② ezighị ezi.
l-m-e6-b03-25.s.s2.model.1: Njehie mbụ bụ iji 100 nke ogologo dịka olu, ya mere o hiere na ②, azịza ziri ezi bụ 2000000 cm³.

l-m-e6-b04-05.title: 18−6÷2×3: ebee ka njehie dị?
l-m-e6-b04-05.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta 18−6÷2×3, ma ọ bụ njikọ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n’usoro ka i wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ e mere njehie.
l-m-e6-b04-05.material: Ngwọta: ① 18−6=12 ② 12÷2=6 ③ 6×3=18. E kwuru na azịza bụ 18, ma uru ziri ezi bụ 9. Chọta nzọụkwụ mbụ hiere.

l-m-e6-b04-05.s.s1.explain: A ga-ebu ụzọ mee ikewa na ịmụba. 6÷2×3=9, 18−9=9.

l-m-e6-b04-05.s.s2.model.1: Ebe ① ezighị ezi, nzọụkwụ niile mechara ezighị ezi. Mezie ya: buru ụzọ 6÷2=3, 3×3=9, 18−9=9.

l-m-e6-b04-13.title: Gịnị ga-eme ma i welie 3449 ugboro abụọ?
l-m-e6-b04-13.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta nke na-ebuli 3449 ruo narị kacha nso, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e6-b04-13.material: Ntụgharị: ① Lelee nkeji 9 ma welie ya ka 3450 ② Lelee iri 5 ma welie ya ka 3500. Uru ziri ezi bụ 3400. Chọta ebe mbụ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s1.o.a: ① E weliri ya na mbụ n'ebe nkeji
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s1.o.b: ② Jiri iwu “welie ma ọ bụrụ na 5 ma ọ bụ karịa”
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s1.r.b: Iwu ahụ ziri ezi. Ma mkpụrụọnụọgụ iri nke 3449 bụ 4.
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s1.r.c: Azịza ahụ ketara nsonaazụ ②, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: 3449 dị nso na 3400. E nwere ihe mehiere.
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s1.explain: Mgbe e weliri ya ruo narị, lelee naanị mkpụrụọnụọgụ iri 4. Ebe 4 dị obere karịa 5, ọ bụ 3400.
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: Naanị ị ga-eleba mkpụrụọnụọgụ iri 4 anya, nke dị n'okpuru ebe ịchọrọ, ma ibuli ahụ malitere n'ebe nkeji. Nke ahụ gbanwere 4 ka ọ bụrụ 5.
l-m-e6-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: A ga-eme iweli naanị otu ugboro, ya mere e kwesịghị ibu ụzọ welie dịka ①. Mkpụrụọnụọgụ iri 4 dị obere karịa 5, ya mere ọ bụ 3400.

l-m-e6-b04-21.title: Ịchọta ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ maka 25% nke pie chart
l-m-e6-b04-21.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta ịchọta ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ maka 25% nke pie chart, ma ọ bụ njikọ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ma mezie ebe mbụ dara.
l-m-e6-b04-21.material: N’ime mmadụ 200 niile, A bụ 25%. Nzọpụta: ① 25%=0.25 ② 200×0.25=500 ③ A bụ mmadụ 500. Chọta nzọụkwụ dara.
l-m-e6-b04-21.s.s1.r.c: E dere unit nke ọma. Nsogbu bụ uru ngụkọta.
l-m-e6-b04-21.s.s1.o.d: Ọ ziri ezi site ná mmalite ruo na njedebe.
l-m-e6-b04-21.s.s1.r.d: A enweghị ike ịdị karịa mmadụ niile (mmadụ 200).
l-m-e6-b04-21.s.s1.explain: 200×0.25=50. Akụkụ enweghị ike ibu karịa ihe niile.
l-m-e6-b04-21.s.s2.model.0: 200×0.25 bụ 1/4 nke 200, ya bụ 50, ma e dere 500. Ya mere ② bụ ebe mbụ dara.
l-m-e6-b04-21.s.s2.model.1: A pụghị ịbụ mmadụ 500, nke karịrị mmadụ 200 niile; ya mere ngụkọta ② ezighi ezi, mgbe e meziri ya ọ bụ mmadụ 50.

l-m-e6-b04-29.title: Ịchọta circumference okirikiri radius ya bụ 5cm
l-m-e6-b04-29.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta circumference okirikiri radius ya bụ 5cm, ma ọ bụ njikọ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ma mezie ebe mbụ dara.
l-m-e6-b04-29.material: Ngwọta: ① Radius bụ 5cm ② Circumference = radius×3.14 = 5×3.14 = 15.7 ③ Circumference nke okirikiri bụ 15.7cm. Uru ziri ezi bụ 31.4cm. Chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru.
l-m-e6-b04-29.s.s1.r.a: A gụrụ radius nke 5cm dị n'nsogbu n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
l-m-e6-b04-29.s.s1.r.d: 5×3.14=15.7 bụ mmịkọrịta ziri ezi. Nkwupụta e dere bụ nsogbu.
l-m-e6-b04-29.s.s1.explain: Circumference bụ diameter×3.14. Diameter bụ 5×2=10cm, ya mere ọ bụ 31.4cm.
l-m-e6-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: Circumference bụ diameter e mịkọrịtara site na 3.14, ma e mịkọrịtara radius. Ya mere rụzie ya ka ọ bụrụ diameter 10cm ma dee 10×3.14, nke na-enye 10×3.14=31.4cm.
l-m-e6-b04-29.s.s2.model.1: Radius bụ ọkara nke diameter, ya mere 5×3.14 bụ ọkara nke circumference. Ya mere a ga-arụzi ②.

l-m-e6-b05-05.title: Ịlele ngwọta nke oke 5:2=□:10
l-m-e6-b05-05.goal: Soro ngwọta oke 5:2=□:10, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe ji eme, n’usoro iji chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ njehie pụtara.
l-m-e6-b05-05.material: Ngwọta: ① Ngwaahịa nke okwu mpụta = nke okwu ime, ya mere 5×10=2×□ ② 50=2×□ ③ □=50×2=100. Chọta usoro mejọrọ.
l-m-e6-b05-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Tọọ ngwaahịa okwu mpụta ka ọ hà nhata na nke okwu ime
l-m-e6-b05-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ □=100, ọ ga-abụ 100:10, nke na-adabaghị 5:2.
l-m-e6-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: Ebe 2×□=50, □ bụ 50÷2=25, mana e mere mmụba. A ga-eme ya 25 ka 5:2=25:10.
l-m-e6-b05-05.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ 100, 100:10 bụ 10:1, nke dị iche na 5:2; ya mere a ga-edozi ③.

l-m-e6-b05-37.goal: Soro ngwọta mpaghara okirikiri nwere dayameta 10 cm, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, nzọụkwụ n'ụzọ nzọụkwụ iji chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-e6-b05-37.material: Ngwọta: ① Mpaghara = radius × radius × 3.14 ② Dayameta bụ 10 cm; ya mere 10×10×3.14=314 ③ Mpaghara bụ 314 cm². Uru ziri ezi bụ 78.5.
l-m-e6-b05-37.s.s1.r.a: Usoro maka mpaghara okirikiri ziri ezi.
l-m-e6-b05-37.s.s1.o.b: ② Tinye dayameta n'ebe radius kwesịrị ịdị
l-m-e6-b05-37.s.s1.r.d: Mgbakọ 10×10=100 ziri ezi. Uru e tinyere bụ nsogbu ahụ.
l-m-e6-b05-37.s.s1.explain: Radius bụ 5 cm; ya mere 5×5×3.14=78.5 cm².
l-m-e6-b05-37.s.s2.model.0: N'ebe radius dị n'ime usoro ahụ, ị kwesịrị itinye 5, ọkara dayameta, ma i tinyere 10. Ya mere dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 5×5×3.14=78.5.
l-m-e6-b05-37.s.s2.model.1: E jiri dayameta 10 cm mee ihe dịka radius; ya mere mpaghara ahụ ji buru ibu ugboro 4. Ya mere a ga-edozi ②.

l-m-e6-b01-26.title: Ịgbanwe ratio 9:25 ka ọ bụrụ pasent
l-m-e6-b01-26.goal: Gbanwee pasent na-egosi ratio 9:25 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (mkpụrụokwu ngụkọta, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e6-b01-26.material: Uru ratio 9:25 bụ 9÷25. A pụrụ igosi uru ratio dịka decimal ma ọ bụ ụmụ irighiri; ịmụba na 100 na-eme ya pasent. Gbanwee otu nha ahụ ka ọ bụrụ pasent.
l-m-e6-b01-26.s.s1.r.a: E jikọtara 9 na 25 wee gụọ ya dịka decimal.
l-m-e6-b01-26.s.s1.r.b: E chere ọdịiche 25−9 dịka uru ratio.
l-m-e6-b01-26.s.s1.r.c: A gbakọrọ 25÷9. Anyị ga-ekewa okwu mbụ na nke abụọ.
l-m-e6-b01-26.s.s2.model.0: 9÷25=0.36, 0.36 mụbara na 100 na-enye 36, ya mere ọ bụ 36%.
l-m-e6-b01-26.s.s2.model.1: 9:25 bụ 9 n'ime square 25. Igbasa ya ka ọ bụrụ square 100 na-eme square 36, ya mere 36%.

l-m-e6-b01-27.goal: Gbanwee ihe 0.6×0.5 pụtara ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (mkpụrụokwu ngụkọta, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e6-b01-27.material: Ka anyị jiri okwu kọwaa ịmụba 0.6×0.5. Ịmụba ọnụọgụ na decimal pụtara ịchọta akụkụ ole nke ọnụọgụ ahụ.
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu nwere otu ihe ahụ na 0.6×0.5?
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s1.r.a: Ịmụba na 0.5 na-eme ya ọkara, ọ bụghị ugboro 2.
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ e nwetara site n’ịgbakwunye 0.5 na 0.6
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s1.r.b: A gbanwere ịmụba ka ọ bụrụ ịgbakwunye.
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụọgụ e nwetara site n’ikewa 0.6 site na 0.5
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s1.r.c: Ịmụba na 0.5 na ikewa site na 0.5 abụghị otu ihe.
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s1.explain: 0.5 bụ ọkara. 0.6×0.5 bụ ọkara nke 0.6, ya bụ 0.3.
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s2.model.0: 0.5 bụ ọkara nke 1, ya mere ịmụba 0.6 na 0.5 na-enye ọkara nke 0.6. Mgbe a gbakọrọ ya, ọ bụ 0.3.
l-m-e6-b01-27.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba 0.6 na 0.5 pụtara ikewa ya ụzọ abụọ, ya mere ọ bụ otu ihe ahụ dịka ọkara nke 0.6.

l-m-e6-b01-28.title: Ịtụgharị 5:3 ka ọ bụrụ oke akụkụ n’ime ngụkọta
l-m-e6-b01-28.goal: Gbanwee oke pensụl anụnụ anụnụ na nke ojii ka ọ bụrụ oke nke ngụkọta n’ụdị ọzọ (nha anya, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e6-b01-28.material: Akpa pensụl nwere pensụl anụnụ anụnụ na ojii n’oke 5:3. Tụgharịa oke ụdị abụọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ oke pensụl ojii n’ime ngụkọta.
l-m-e6-b01-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu akụkụ ngụkọta bụ pensụl ojii?
l-m-e6-b01-28.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ oke ọnụ ọgụgụ pensụl ojii n’ebe pensụl anụnụ anụnụ nọ. Ngụkọta abụghị ntọala.
l-m-e6-b01-28.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ oke pensụl anụnụ anụnụ n’ime ngụkọta.
l-m-e6-b01-28.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ngụkọta e kewara site na pensụl ojii. E dere ya n’usoro na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-e6-b01-28.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta bụ 5+3=8, n’ime ha 3 bụ pensụl ojii. Pensụl ojii bụ 3/8 nke ngụkọta.
l-m-e6-b01-28.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbakwunye pensụl anụnụ anụnụ 5 na ojii 3 na-enye ngụkọta 8, ya mere pensụl ojii bụ 3/8 nke ngụkọta.
l-m-e6-b01-28.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na i kee ngụkọta ahụ ụzọ 8, pensụl ojii na-ewe akụkụ 3, ya mere a pụrụ ide ya ọzọ dịka 3/8.

l-m-e6-b01-29.title: Ịtụgharị okirikiri gburugburu ka ọ bụrụ usoro maka dayameta
l-m-e6-b01-29.goal: Dee usoro ịchọta dayameta site na okirikiri gburugburu n’ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e6-b01-29.material: Okirikiri gburugburu bụ dayameta × pi (3.14). Mgbe ogologo gburugburu okirikiri bụ 31.4 cm, tụgharịa mmekọrịta a ka i wee nweta usoro maka dayameta.
l-m-e6-b01-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro ziri ezi iji chọta dayameta?
l-m-e6-b01-29.s.s1.r.a: Nke a jiri pi mụbaa okirikiri gburugburu. A na-achọta dayameta site n’ikewa okirikiri gburugburu site na pi.
l-m-e6-b01-29.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ usoro radius, ọ bụghị dayameta.
l-m-e6-b01-29.s.s1.r.c: Nke a ji iwepụ. Ịtụgharị mmekọrịta ịmụba na-enye ikewa.
l-m-e6-b01-29.s.s1.explain: Ebe okirikiri gburugburu = dayameta × 3.14, dayameta = okirikiri gburugburu ÷ 3.14. Ebe 31.4÷3.14=10, ọ bụ 10 cm.
l-m-e6-b01-29.s.s2.model.0: Ebe ihe megidere ịmụba bụ ikewa, dayameta bụ okirikiri gburugburu e kewara site na pi: 31.4÷3.14=10.
l-m-e6-b01-29.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba dayameta na 3.14 na-enye 31.4; ya mere ikewa 31.4 site na 3.14 na-enye dayameta 10 cm.

l-m-e6-b01-30.title: Ikwu 25% dịka ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ
l-m-e6-b01-30.goal: Dee 25% nke ndị họọrọ “amasị m” na nyocha n’ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e6-b01-30.material: N’ime nyocha, 25% nke ndị mmadụ họọrọ “amasị m.” 25% pụtara 25 n’ime 100, hà nhata 1/4 nke ngụkọta. Ka anyị kwuo otu ihe ahụ dịka ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ.
l-m-e6-b01-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara na 25%?
l-m-e6-b01-30.s.s1.explain: 25%=25/100=1/4. O nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara dịka ikwu na mmadụ 1 n’ime 4 na-amasị ya.
l-m-e6-b01-30.s.s2.model.0: 25% bụ 25/100; ime ka irighiri ahụ dị mfe na-enye 1/4, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ dịka ikwu na mmadụ 1 n’ime 4.
l-m-e6-b01-30.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na i kee ngụkọta ahụ hà nhata ụzọ 4, otu akụkụ bụ 25%; ya mere ọ bụ otu ihe ahụ dịka mmadụ 1 n’ime 4.

l-m-e6-b02-27.s.s1.r.b: N’ime nkeji 1, ọ na-aga 1 km, ọ bụghị 6 km.

l-m-e6-b02-27.s.s1.explain: Ọ na-aga 60 km n’otu awa (nkeji 60), ya mere n’ime nkeji 30 ọ na-aga ọkara nke ahụ, 30 km.
l-m-e6-b02-27.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-aga 60 km n’otu awa, ya mere n’ime nkeji 30 ọ na-aga ọkara, 30 km; nke a bụ otu ọsọ ahụ.

l-m-e6-b02-28.material: Oke 0.6:0.9 bụ oke e dere na ntụpọ. Oke ahụ na-adị otu ma ọ bụrụ na i jiri otu ọnụọgụ mụbaa ma ọ bụ kewaa okwu mbụ na nke abụọ ya. Ka anyị dee otu oke ahụ dịka oke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu kacha dị mfe.

l-m-e6-b02-29.title: Ide mpaghara elu dịka ngosipụta
l-m-e6-b02-29.goal: Tụgharịa ngosipụta mpaghara elu prism akụkụ anọ ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e6-b02-29.material: E nwere prism akụkụ anọ dị ogologo 3 cm, obosara 4 cm, ịdị elu 5 cm. Prism akụkụ anọ nwere ụzọ ihu atọ nke ọ bụla bụ otu nha. Ka anyị mee nke a ngosipụta maka ịchọta mpaghara elu.
l-m-e6-b02-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ngosipụta na-enye mpaghara elu nke ọma?
l-m-e6-b02-29.s.s1.r.a: Ị gbakwunyere naanị otu ihu n’ime ụzọ ihu 3 ahụ. Ị ga-amụba na 2.
l-m-e6-b02-29.s.s1.r.c: Ị gbakwunyere naanị ogologo ma mụbaa na 2. Ị ga-agbakwunye mpaghara ihu ndị ahụ.
l-m-e6-b02-29.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ngosipụta maka olu.
l-m-e6-b02-29.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara ụzọ ihu atọ ahụ bụ 12, 20 na 15. E nwere abụọ n’ime nke ọ bụla, ya mere 2×47=94 cm².
l-m-e6-b02-29.s.s2.model.0: E nwere ụzọ ihu atọ, ihu ndị dị n’ụzọ nke ọ bụla nwekwara otu mpaghara, ya mere mụbaa ngụkọta otu ihu n’ụzọ nke ọ bụla, 47, na 2 ka ị nweta 94.
l-m-e6-b02-29.s.s2.model.1: E nwere ihu abụọ n’elu na n’okpuru, ihu na ihu azụ, na ihu aka ekpe na aka nri; ya mere a pụrụ ide ya dịka 2×(3×4+4×5+3×5).

l-m-e6-b02-30.material: Ị mere mgbatị ahụ awa 1.25. 1 awa bụ nkeji 60. Ka anyị kwuo otu oge ahụ site n’ikewa ya ka ọ bụrụ “awa” na “nkeji.”
l-m-e6-b02-30.s.s1.prompt: Awa ole na nkeji ole ka awa 1.25 bụ?
l-m-e6-b02-30.s.s1.r.a: O yiri ka a gụrụ awa 0.2 dịka nkeji 12. Ọ bụ awa 0.25.
l-m-e6-b02-30.s.s1.r.b: Ị bugara akara ntụpọ nke 0.25. Awa 0.25 bụ nkeji 15.
l-m-e6-b02-30.s.s1.r.c: Ị gụrụ ntụpọ 0.25 dịka nkeji 25. Awa 0.25 bụ 1/4 nke nkeji 60.

l-m-e6-b03-26.material: Ntụpọ 0.3 hà nhata 3/10, 0.7 hà nhata 7/10. Tụgharịa ịmụba 0.3×0.7 ka ọ bụrụ ịmụba irighiri iji gosi otu uru ahụ.
l-m-e6-b03-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ngosipụta irighiri nwere otu uru ahụ na 0.3×0.7?
l-m-e6-b03-26.s.s1.r.c: I dere 0.3 n’amaghị ama dịka 3/100. 0.3 bụ 3/10.

l-m-e6-b03-27.title: Nkeji 40 dịka irighiri nke otu awa

l-m-e6-b03-27.material: 1 awa bụ nkeji 60. Tụgharịa nkeji 40 ka ọ bụrụ irighiri nkeji “awa.”
l-m-e6-b03-27.s.s1.r.b: I chere na 1 awa nwere nkeji 100 n’amaghị ama.
l-m-e6-b03-27.s.s1.r.c: Ị gụrụ ya dịka 40 e kewara site na 10. 1 awa bụ nkeji 60.

l-m-e6-b03-27.s.s2.model.0: Ebe 1 awa bụ nkeji 60, nkeji 40 bụ 40/60; ime ka irighiri ahụ dị mfe na-enye awa 2/3.

l-m-e6-b03-28.title: Nha anya na obosara mgbe mpaghara na-adị otu
l-m-e6-b03-28.goal: Tụgharịa mmekọrịta dị n’etiti ogologo na obosara akụkụ anọ nke mpaghara ya na-adị mgbe niile 24 cm² ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e6-b03-28.material: Mpaghara akụkụ anọ bụ 24 cm² mgbe niile. Ka ogologo bụrụ x cm, obosara bụrụ y cm; tụgharịa mmekọrịta dị n’etiti ha site n’okwu ka ọ bụrụ nha anya.
l-m-e6-b03-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nha anya na-egosi mmekọrịta x na y?
l-m-e6-b03-28.s.s1.r.a: Ị kewara ya n’usoro na-ezighị ezi. Ogologo × obosara = 24.
l-m-e6-b03-28.s.s1.r.c: Ị jiri iwepụ dee ya. Mpaghara bụ ogologo × obosara.
l-m-e6-b03-28.s.s1.r.d: Ị mụbara ya. Mgbe ogologo na-abawanye, obosara na-ebelata.
l-m-e6-b03-28.s.s1.explain: Ebe ogologo × obosara = 24, obosara bụ y=24÷x. Ọ bụrụ na ogologo aghọọ okpukpu 2, obosara ga-abụ ọkara.
l-m-e6-b03-28.s.s2.model.0: Ebe mpaghara bụ ogologo × obosara, x×y=24; ikewa akụkụ abụọ ahụ site na x na-enye y=24÷x.
l-m-e6-b03-28.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe ogologo bụ 4, obosara bụ 6; mgbe ogologo bụ 6, obosara bụ 4, ya mere obosara bụ 24 e kewara site na ogologo.

l-m-e6-b03-29.title: Ide 2/3 ka ọ bụrụ irighiri nwere denominator 12
l-m-e6-b03-29.goal: Tụgharịa irighiri hà nhata 2/3 nke denominator ya bụ 12 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e6-b03-29.material: Ị chọrọ ide irighiri hà nhata 2/3 nke denominator ya bụ 12. Ọ bụrụ na i jiri otu ọnụọgụ mụbaa denominator na numerator, nha ya ga-adị otu.
l-m-e6-b03-29.s.s1.r.a: Ị gbakwunyere 9 i tinyere na denominator na numerator kwa.
l-m-e6-b03-29.s.s1.r.b: Ị gbanwere naanị denominator. Ị ga-amụbakwa numerator na otu ọnụọgụ ahụ.
l-m-e6-b03-29.s.s1.explain: Ịmụba denominator 3 na 4 na-enye 12, ya mere mụbaa numerator 2 na 4 kwa. 2/3=8/12.
l-m-e6-b03-29.s.s2.model.0: Ị mụbara denominator 3 na 4 ka ọ bụrụ 12, ya mere 8/12, nke numerator 2 ya mụbara na 4 kwa, hà nhata nha.
l-m-e6-b03-29.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ 2 n’ime akụkụ 3 na-aghọ akụkụ 8 n’ime akụkụ 12 mgbe e kewara ya ụzọ 12, ya mere 2/3=8/12.

l-m-e6-b03-30.material: Mmiri na-esi na pọmpụ apụta nwayọọ nwayọọ, 3.5 L kwa nkeji 1. Kwuo otu ọsọ ahụ n’okwu ọzọ.
l-m-e6-b03-30.s.s1.r.a: Ị dere ọnụọgụ n’usoro na-ezighị ezi. N’ime nkeji 7 ọ bụ 24.5 L.

l-m-e6-b03-30.s.s1.r.d: Ị gbakwunyere 2 na 3.5. N’ime nkeji 2, ọ bụ 3.5 ugboro 2.

l-m-e6-b03-30.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ 3.5 L n’ime nkeji 1, ya mere n’ime nkeji 2 mmiri okpukpu 2, 7 L, na-apụta; nke a pụtara na 7 L n’ime nkeji 2 bụ otu ọsọ ahụ.

l-m-e6-b04-22.title: Okirikiri dayameta ya bụ 14cm, iji radius
l-m-e6-b04-22.goal: Gbanwee okwu circumference okirikiri ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, foto, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu.
l-m-e6-b04-22.material: Circumference okirikiri dayameta ya bụ 14cm bụ 14×3.14. Anyị chọrọ igosi ya site na radius 7cm.
l-m-e6-b04-22.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ okwu nwere otu uru na nke mbụ.
l-m-e6-b04-22.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ okwu iji chọta mpaghara okirikiri.
l-m-e6-b04-22.s.s1.r.b: E ji dayameta 14 mee ihe, ma mụbaa ya na 2 ọzọ. Nke a bụ okpukpu 2 circumference.
l-m-e6-b04-22.s.s1.explain: Dayameta bụ okpukpu 2 radius, ya mere 14×3.14=2×7×3.14=43.96.
l-m-e6-b04-22.s.s2.model.0: Dayameta 14 bụ 2×7; ya mere ọ bụrụgodị na ị gbanwee 14×3.14 ka ọ bụrụ 2×7×3.14, uru ahụ bụ otu.
l-m-e6-b04-22.s.s2.model.1: Dayameta bụ okpukpu 2 radius; ya mere circumference bụ radius mụbara na 2 na 3.14.

l-m-e6-b04-30.title: Ịgbanwe nkezi nke akara 8.4 ka ọ bụrụ ngụkọta
l-m-e6-b04-30.goal: Gbanwee nkezi nke akara 8.4 ka ọ bụrụ udi ọzọ (nkwupụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e6-b04-30.material: Nkezi akara nke mmadụ 5 bụ akara 8.4. Ka anyị gbanwee nkezi ahụ ka ọ bụrụ udi nke ngụkọta akara nke mmadụ 5.
l-m-e6-b04-30.s.s1.r.b: E kewara 8.4 site na 5. A na-achọta ngụkọta site n'ịmịkọrịta.
l-m-e6-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: E gbakwunyere 5 n'8.4. Iji nweta ngụkọta site n'nkezi, ị na-amịkọrịta.
l-m-e6-b04-30.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ naanị nkezi. Ọ gbanweghị ka ọ bụrụ ngụkọta.
l-m-e6-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Nkezi × ọnụọgụ mmadụ = ngụkọta, ya mere 8.4×5=akara 42.
l-m-e6-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Nkezi bụ ngụkọta kewara site n'ọnụọgụ mmadụ, ya mere ngụkọta bụ 8.4×5=akara 42.
l-m-e6-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: Onye ọ bụla nwere akara 8.4 ma e nwere mmadụ 5, ya mere ngụkọta bụ akara 42, nke bụ 8.4 e gbakwunyere ugboro 5.

l-m-e6-b04-38.title: Ide mgbakọ e nyere n'okwu dịka nkwupụta
l-m-e6-b04-38.goal: Gbanwee "ọnụọgụ ị na-enweta site n'ịmịkọrịta nchikota nke 3 na 4 site na 5" ka ọ bụrụ udi ọzọ (nkwupụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e6-b04-38.material: Anyị chọrọ ide "ọnụọgụ ị na-enweta site n'ịmịkọrịta nchikota nke 3 na 4 site na 5" dịka nkwupụta.
l-m-e6-b04-38.s.s1.r.a: E buru ụzọ mee mmịkọrịta, malite site n'4×5. A ga-ebu ụzọ mee nchikota.
l-m-e6-b04-38.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ ị na-amịkọrịta na ọnụọgụ ị na-agbakwunye dị iche n'nkwupụta ndị a.
l-m-e6-b04-38.s.s1.r.d: Ọ kwuru ka e mịkọrịta, ma naanị ịgbakwunye ka e mere.
l-m-e6-b04-38.s.s1.explain: Iji mee nchikota buru ụzọ, ị chọrọ parentheses. (3+4)×5=35.
l-m-e6-b04-38.s.s2.model.0: Ị ghaghị ibu ụzọ chọta nchikota nke 3 na 4, ya mere ị na-etinye ya n'ime parentheses ma dee (3+4)×5.
l-m-e6-b04-38.s.s2.model.1: N'enweghị parentheses, mmịkọrịta na-abịa mbụ, ya mere 3+4×5 na-aghọ 23 ma ihe ọ pụtara na-agbanwe.

l-m-e6-b05-06.goal: Gbanwee akụkụ 5 cm dị na band graph gaa n’ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwakwa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e6-b05-06.material: N’ime band graph ogologo ya dum bụ 20 cm, akụkụ A dị 5 cm. Ka anyị gosi A dịka pasent.
l-m-e6-b05-06.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị ka e ji 15, nke bụ ihe fọdụrụ mgbe e wepụrụ 5 na mkpokọta, mee ihe. Oke bụ nkewa.
l-m-e6-b05-06.s.s1.r.c: E kewara ya n’ụzọ megidere, dịka 20÷5=4.
l-m-e6-b05-06.s.s1.r.d: E dere ogologo 5 cm ozugbo dịka %.

l-m-e6-b01-31.title: N’ime blọk 24 ahụ, ọdịdị dị aṅaa nwere mpaghara elu pere mpe?
l-m-e6-b01-31.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere mpaghara elu prism akụkụ anọ abụọ e ji blọk 24 wuo, họrọ nke dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe mere.
l-m-e6-b01-31.material: Jiri blọk 24 wuo prism akụkụ anọ n’enweghị oghere. Ewuru A ka obosara ya bụrụ 2, ogologo 3, ịdị elu 4; ewuru B ka obosara ya bụrụ 1, ogologo 4, ịdị elu 6. Were mpaghara otu ihu blọk dịka 1.
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke nwere mpaghara elu pere mpe, gịnịkwa mere?
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.o.a: A: n’ihi na 68 dị obere karịa 52
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.o.b: A: n’ihi na 52 dị obere karịa 68
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.o.c: B: n’ihi na e kpokọtara ya ogologo, ya mere ihu mpụta ya dị ole na ole
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.r.c: Ka ị na-ekpokọta ya ogologo, ihu ndị ọzọ na-apụta n’èzí.
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.o.d: Ha hà: n’ihi na ha abụọ nwere blọk 24
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma ọnụ ọgụgụ blọk hà, mpaghara elu na-agbanwe dabere n’ụdị e wuru.
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara elu A bụ 2×(6+8+12)=52, nke B bụkwa 2×(4+6+24)=68.
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s2.model.0: A bụ 52, B bụ 68, ya mere mpaghara elu A pere mpe.
l-m-e6-b01-31.s.s2.model.1: Ka akụkụ ya na-adịkwu nha ibe ha, ihu ole na ole na-apụta n’èzí; ya mere 2×3×4 nwere mpaghara elu pere mpe karịa 1×4×6.

l-m-e6-b04-15.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka iji atụnyere ọnụ ahịa apụl, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-e6-b04-15.material: Otu ụlọ ahịa na-ere apụl 4 na 4,000 won, nke ọzọ na-ere apụl 8 na 6,000 won. A sịrị, “Ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa ka ukwuu pụtara ọnụ karịa,” B sịrị, “Ị ga-atụnyere ọnụ ahịa otu apụl.”
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s1.o.a: A: Ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa ka ukwuu pụtara ọnụ karịa
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe dị iche, ịnweghị ike iji ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa naanị tụnyere.
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s1.o.b: B: Ị ga-atụnyere ọnụ ahịa otu
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s1.r.c: Iji tụnyere ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa na-arụ ọrụ naanị mgbe ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe hà nhata.
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s1.r.d: Ị nwere ike iji ọnụ ahịa otu tụnyere (1,000 won na 750 won).
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s1.explain: Ọnụ ahịa otu 1 bụ 1,000 won na 750 won, ya mere ngwugwu apụl 8 dị ọnụ ala.
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe dị iche, tụnyere ọnụ ahịa otu 1, ya mere B ziri ezi. Ọnụ ahịa bụ 1,000 won na 750 won.
l-m-e6-b04-15.s.s2.model.1: A pụghị iji ngụkọta ọnụ ahịa tụnyere n'ihi na ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe dị iche. Mgbe e ji ọnụ ahịa otu 1 tụnyere, ụlọ ahịa 750 won dị ọnụ ala, ya mere B ziri ezi.

l-m-e6-b05-31.title: Ngụkọta akara klaasị nwere nkezi ka elu ọ na-abụkarị nnukwu?
l-m-e6-b05-31.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta gbasara atụnyere ngụkọta akara klaasị abụọ, họrọ nke ka mma, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e6-b05-31.material: N'ule, nkezi ụmụ akwụkwọ 5 nọ na Klaasị A bụ akara 90, nkezi ụmụ akwụkwọ 30 nọ na Klaasị B bụ akara 80. A kwuru, 'Nkezi ahụ ka elu, ya mere ngụkọta Klaasị A karịrị,' B kwuru, 'Ị ga-amụba site n'ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.'
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s1.o.a: A: Ngụkọta Klaasị A ka ukwuu
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s1.r.a: Ngụkọta Klaasị A bụ 450, nke Klaasị B bụ 2400; ya mere nke Klaasị B ka ukwuu.
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s1.o.b: B: Ị ga-amụba site n'ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ iji tụnyere
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: Nkwubi okwu A ezighị ezi; ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu.
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s1.o.d: Ị nwere ike ịmata ngụkọta site na nkezi naanị
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche, ị gaghị amata ngụkọta site na nkezi naanị.
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta = nkezi × ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ; ya mere Klaasị A nwere akara 450, Klaasị B nwekwara akara 2400.
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: Ngụkọta Klaasị A bụ 90×5=450, nke Klaasị B bụ 80×30=2400; ya mere ị ga-amụba site n'ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dịka B kwuru.
l-m-e6-b05-31.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma nkezi ka elu, ngụkọta na-adị ntakịrị ma ụmụ akwụkwọ dị ole na ole; ya mere A ezighị ezi.

l-m-e6-b01-36.title: Olee otú anyị kwesịrị isi jiri ihe ndị e ji eme mgwakota kuki?
l-m-e6-b01-36.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha gbasara ntụ ọka na butter maka mgwakota kuki, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara, kọwaa ihe mere.
l-m-e6-b01-36.material: A ga-eme mgwakota kuki site n’ịgwakọta ntụ ọka na butter n’oke 5:2. N’ụlọ e nwere ntụ ọka 400 g na butter 120 g. Ka oke ahụ dịgide, họrọ ego kacha ukwuu a pụrụ ime.
l-m-e6-b01-36.s.s1.prompt: Ego ole nke ihe nke ọ bụla ka kacha mma iji?

l-m-e6-b01-36.s.s1.r.d: Ọ chọrọ butter 160 g, ma e nwere naanị 120 g.
l-m-e6-b01-36.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na i kwekọọ na butter 120 g, ntụ ọka ga-abụ 300 g. 300:120=5:2, ọ bụkwa nke kacha ukwuu n’ime ihe i nwere.
l-m-e6-b01-36.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i jiri butter niile, oke 5:2 na-eme ka ntụ ọka bụrụ 300 g, nke dị n’ime 400 g, ya mere ị nwere ike ime nke kacha ukwuu.
l-m-e6-b01-36.s.s2.model.1: 300:120 bụ otu ihe ahụ na 5:2, butter agaghịkwa ezu, ya mere nke a bụ ego kacha ukwuu na-edobe oke ahụ.

l-m-e6-b01-39.title: Debe ibu akpa ka ọ bụrụ 10% nke ibu ahụ ma ọ bụ obere
l-m-e6-b01-39.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha gbasara ibu ihe a ga-etinye n'akpa, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e6-b01-39.material: Maka nwa akwụkwọ ibu ya bụ 38 kg, ibu akpa ga-abụ 10% nke ibu ahụ ma ọ bụ obere. Tinyere ihe ndị a ga-etinye 2.4 kg, ị chọrọ ịhọrọ akwụkwọ (0.9 kg), jaket (0.7 kg), nri nta (0.5 kg), ma kwakọba ibu dị ka o kwere mee.
l-m-e6-b01-39.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ 3.6 kg, nke mezuru ọnọdụ, ma ị nwere ike ịkwakọba karịa.
l-m-e6-b01-39.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ 3.3 kg, nke mezuru ọnọdụ, ma ị nwere ike ịkwakọba karịa.
l-m-e6-b01-39.s.s1.explain: 10% nke ibu ahụ bụ 3.8 kg. Ịgbakwunye akwụkwọ na nri nta na-enye 2.4+0.9+0.5=3.8 kg.
l-m-e6-b01-39.s.s2.model.0: Ọ ga-abụ 3.8 kg ma ọ bụ obere; akwụkwọ na nri nta na-eme kpọmkwem 3.8 kg, ya mere ọ mezuru ọnọdụ ma bụrụ ibu kacha arọ.
l-m-e6-b01-39.s.s2.model.1: Akwụkwọ na jaket na-eme 4.0 kg, nke karịrị oke. Ndị ọzọ dị mfe, ya mere akwụkwọ na nri nta kacha mma.

l-m-e6-b01-40.title: Ikesa nkeji 90 n'etiti nkwadebe na ngosi
l-m-e6-b01-40.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ikesa nkeji 90 maka ọrụ otu, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e6-b01-40.material: N'ime nkeji 90 nke ọrụ otu, nkeji 10 bụ maka imechi, ndị fọdụrụ bụ nkwadebe na ngosi. Oge ngosi agaghị akarị 1/3 nke mkpokọta, nkwadebe ga-abụ opekata mpe okpukpu 2 nke ngosi. Ị chọrọ ime ka ngosi dị ogologo dịka o kwere mee. (nkeji)
l-m-e6-b01-40.s.s1.prompt: Nkeji ole maka nkwadebe na ngosi kacha mma?
l-m-e6-b01-40.s.s1.r.a: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, ma ị nwere ike ime ka ngosi dị ogologo.
l-m-e6-b01-40.s.s1.r.b: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, ma ị nwere ike ime ka ngosi dị ogologo.
l-m-e6-b01-40.s.s1.r.d: Nkwadebe erughị nkeji 60, nke bụ okpukpu 2 nke ngosi.
l-m-e6-b01-40.s.s1.explain: Nkwadebe nkeji 54 karịrị nkeji 52, nke bụ okpukpu 2 nke ngosi nkeji 26. Oge ngosi nkeji 26 bụ nke kachasị ogologo.
l-m-e6-b01-40.s.s2.model.0: Site n'ihe ngosi nkeji 26, nkwadebe bụ nkeji 54, nke dịkarịa ala 52, mkpokọta bụ nkeji 90. Ya mere ọnọdụ mezuru, ọ bụkwa nke kachasị ogologo.
l-m-e6-b01-40.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ngosi bụ nkeji 27, nkwadebe ga-abụ nkeji 53, ma a chọrọ 54. Ya mere ọ gaghị ezu, nke na-eme nkeji 26 ka ọ bụrụ nke kachasị.

l-m-e6-b02-36.title: Kọmitii ahụ kwesịrị inwe mmadụ ole?
l-m-e6-b02-36.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha gbasara ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị otu kọmitii a ga-ahọrọ n’ime ụmụ akwụkwọ 47, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara, kọwaa ihe mere.
l-m-e6-b02-36.material: Ị ga-ahọrọ ndị otu kọmitii n’ime ụmụ akwụkwọ 47 niile. Kọmitii ahụ ga-enwe opekata mpe 20% nke ụmụ akwụkwọ niile ma ọ gaghị akarị mmadụ 12; ịchọrọkwa ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ya dịrị ntakịrị o kwere mee.
l-m-e6-b02-36.s.s1.r.b: 20% nke 47 bụ mmadụ 9.4, ya mere mmadụ 9 erughị 20%.
l-m-e6-b02-36.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma a pụrụ ibelata ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ ọzọ.
l-m-e6-b02-36.s.s1.explain: 20% nke 47 bụ mmadụ 9.4. Ọnụọgụ zuru ezu kacha nta nke dịkarịa ala 9.4 bụ mmadụ 10.
l-m-e6-b02-36.s.s2.model.0: 20% nke 47 bụ 9.4, ya mere mmadụ 9 dị ole na ole, mmadụ 10 bụkwa ọnụ ọgụgụ kacha nta ruru opekata mpe 20%.
l-m-e6-b02-36.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ mmadụ ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu; ya mere ịgbakọta 9.4 elu ka ọ bụrụ 10 bụ nhọrọ kacha nta na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.

l-m-e6-b02-37.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka ubi nke ogologo na obosara ya dị n’oke 3:2, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara, kọwaa ihe mere.
l-m-e6-b02-37.material: Mee ubi akụkụ anọ nke ogologo na obosara ya dị n’oke 3:2, perimeter ya bụrụ 50 m ma ọ bụ pekarịa. Ogologo ya bụ ọnụọgụ mita zuru ezu, ịchọrọkwa ka ubi ahụ buru ibu o kwere mee.
l-m-e6-b02-37.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ 3:2, ma perimeter ya bụ 60 m, nke karịrị 50 m.

l-m-e6-b02-37.s.s1.explain: 15:10 bụ 3:2, perimeter ya bụ 2×(15+10)=50 m. Mpaghara ya bụ 150 m², nke kacha ukwuu.
l-m-e6-b02-37.s.s2.model.0: 15:10 bụ 3:2, perimeter ya bụ 50 m, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ; mpaghara 150 m² ya karịrị 96 m² nke 12×8.

l-m-e6-b02-38.material: Tankị mmanụ 40 L nwere 1/4 fọdụrụ ugbu a. A pụrụ itinye mmanụ naanị n’ụzọ nke 5 L, tankị ahụ agaghịkwa ejupụta karịa 9/10. Ị chọrọ itinye nke kacha ukwuu o kwere mee.

l-m-e6-b02-38.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụghị ọtụtụ nke nkeji 5 L.
l-m-e6-b02-38.s.s1.r.d: Ọ ka erughị oke ndoju. Ị nwere ike itinyekwu.
l-m-e6-b02-38.s.s1.explain: 9/10 nke tankị bụ 36 L, mmanụ 10 L dị ugbu a, ya mere i nwere ike itinye ruo 26 L. N’ụzọ nke 5 L, nke ahụ bụ 25 L.
l-m-e6-b02-38.s.s2.model.0: Ị nwere ike imeju ruo 36 L, mmanụ 10 L dị ugbu a, ya mere a pụrụ itinye ruo 26 L; ma n’ụzọ nke 5 L, 25 L bụ nke kacha ukwuu.
l-m-e6-b02-38.s.s2.model.1: Itinye 30 L na-eme ngụkọta 40 L, nke karịrị 36 L, ya mere 25 L kacha mma.

l-m-e6-b02-39.material: Tankị ahụ dị ogologo 40 cm, obosara 25 cm, ịdị elu 30 cm. Ị na-awụnye mmiri site na karama 1.5 L, ịdị elu mmiri agaghị akarị 24 cm, a pụkwara iji naanị karama zuru ezu. Wụnye ọtụtụ o kwere mee.
l-m-e6-b02-39.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ 25.5 cm, nke karịrị 24 cm.
l-m-e6-b02-39.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ 22.5 cm, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma ị nwere ike itinyekwu otu karama.
l-m-e6-b02-39.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ 21 cm, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma ị nwere ike ịwụnyekwu.
l-m-e6-b02-39.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara ala bụ 1000 cm², ya mere mmiri na-arị elu 1 cm maka 1 L ọ bụla. Karama 16 bụ 24 L, nke bụ 24 cm.
l-m-e6-b02-39.s.s2.model.0: Ala ahụ bụ 40×25=1000 cm², ya mere karama 16, ya bụ 24 L, na-eme ka mmiri ruo 24 cm ma na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.
l-m-e6-b02-39.s.s2.model.1: Karama 17 na-eme ka mmiri ruo 25.5 cm, nke karịrị 24 cm, ya mere karama 16 bụ nke kacha ukwuu a pụrụ ịwụnye.

l-m-e6-b03-36.s.s1.explain: Ngwugwu 2 na-enye pensụl 24, tinye 1 pensụl ka ọ bụrụ 25. 6000+300=6300 won, nke kacha dị ọnụ ala.

l-m-e6-b03-39.title: Ime ubi akwụkwọ nri n’akụkụ mgbidi
l-m-e6-b03-39.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka ubi akwụkwọ nri akụkụ anọ e wuru n’akụkụ mgbidi, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara, kọwaa ihe mere.
l-m-e6-b03-39.material: Ị na-eme ubi akwụkwọ nri akụkụ anọ nke akụkụ ogologo ya dị n’akụkụ mgbidi. A chọghị ngere n’akụkụ mgbidi, ya mere ị na-etinye ngere naanị n’akụkụ atọ ndị ọzọ. Ogologo ngere ahụ agaghị akarị 20 m, ogologo akụkụ ya bụ ọnụọgụ mita zuru ezu, ịchọrọkwa ka ubi ahụ buru ibu o kwere mee.
l-m-e6-b03-39.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ogologo (n’akụkụ mgbidi) na obosara kacha dabara?
l-m-e6-b03-39.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-eme ka ngere bụrụ 20 m, ma mpaghara 48 m² ka ị nwere ike ime ka o too.
l-m-e6-b03-39.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-eme ka ngere bụrụ 20 m, ma mpaghara 48 m² ka ị nwere ike ime ka o too.

l-m-e6-b05-08.material: A ga-enwerịrị oche maka mmadụ 103 niile. Bọs oche 45 na-efu 30×10,000 won (300,000 won) nke ọ bụla; bọs oche 25 na-efu 18×10,000 won (180,000 won). Họrọ atụmatụ kacha ọnụ ala.
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-efu 90×10,000 won (900,000 won), karịa atụmatụ ndị ọzọ.
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s1.r.b: Naanị mmadụ 100 nwere ike ịnọ ọdụ; mmadụ 3 agaghị enwe oche.
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s1.o.c: Bọs 2 nwere oche 45 + bọs 1 nwere oche 25
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s1.o.d: Bọs 1 nwere oche 45 + bọs 3 nwere oche 25
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-efu 84×10,000 won (840,000 won), ma e nwere atụmatụ dị ọnụ ala karịa.
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s1.explain: O nwere oche 115 ka mmadụ niile nwee ike ịnọdụ; ọnụ ahịa 78×10,000 won (780,000 won) bụ nke kacha nta n’atụmatụ mezuru ọnọdụ.
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s2.model.0: Bọs 2 nwere oche 45 na bọs 1 nwere oche 25 na-enye oche 115, na-efu 78×10,000 won (780,000 won); mmadụ niile ga-anọdụ, ọ bụkwa nke kacha ọnụ ala.
l-m-e6-b05-08.s.s2.model.1: Bọs 4 nwere oche 25 nwere oche 100, ya mere mmadụ 3 enweghị ike ịnọdụ; wepụ ya, họrọ nke kacha ọnụ ala n’etiti ndị fọdụrụ.

l-m-e6-b05-16.title: Ọnụọgụ ite agba maka mgbidi ụlọ
l-m-e6-b05-16.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ọnụọgụ ite agba, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e6-b05-16.material: Ị ga-ete mgbidi anọ nke ọnụ ụlọ dị ogologo 5 m, obosara 4 m, ịdị elu 2.5 m. Agaghị ete ọnụ ụzọ na windo, nke bụ 5.5 m². Otu ite na-ekpuchi 10 m², a na-erekwa naanị ite zuru ezu. Zụta nke kacha nta n'enweghị ụkọ.
l-m-e6-b05-16.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ite ziri ezi.
l-m-e6-b05-16.s.s1.r.a: A na-ere naanị ite zuru ezu, ya mere a pụghị ịzụta ite 4.5.
l-m-e6-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Ite 4 ezuola. Lelee ma ewepụrụ mpaghara ọnụ ụzọ na windo.
l-m-e6-b05-16.s.s1.r.d: Ite 3 na-ekpuchi 30 m², nke ezughị 39.5 m² a ga-ete.
l-m-e6-b05-16.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara mgbidi bụ 18×2.5=45 m², wepụ ọnụ ụzọ na windo na-enye 39.5 m², ya mere ite 4 (40 m²) ezuola.
l-m-e6-b05-16.s.s2.model.0: 45−5.5=39.5 m², ite 4 na-ekpuchi 40 m², ya mere zụta nke kacha nta n'enweghị ụkọ.
l-m-e6-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na e wepụghị ọnụ ụzọ na windo, ọ bụ 45 m², ị ga-azụ ite 5, nke bụ ịla n'iyi; ya mere ite 4 ziri ezi.

l-m-e6-b05-24.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha gbasara nha igbe achicha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e6-b05-24.material: Ị ga-etinye achicha okirikiri dayameta 20 cm, ịdị elu 8 cm n'ime igbe nwere ntọala akụkụ anọ. Achicha ga-adaba, ị chọkwara iji akwụkwọ kacha nta. Igbe bụ ogologo×obosara×ịdị elu (cm).

l-m-e6-b05-24.s.s1.explain: N'ime igbe achicha dabara, nke nwere mpaghara elu kacha nta bụ 20×20×8 (1440 cm²).

l-m-e6-b05-32.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ịzụta mkpụrụ a ga-akụ n'akwa ifuru, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e6-b05-32.material: Ị ga-akụ mkpụrụ n'akwa ifuru okirikiri nke radius ya bụ 3 m. Akpa otu na-ekpuchi 8 m² ma na-efu won 3000, ùkwù (uru ya hà akpa 2) na-efu won 5000. Zụta ya n'ụzọ kacha dị ọnụ ala n'ebughị ụzọ kpụ ọkụ n'ọnụ.

l-m-e6-b05-32.s.s1.r.b: 24 m² ezughị maka mpaghara akwa ifuru nke 28.26 m².
l-m-e6-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: O zuru, ma na won 12000 e nwere atụmatụ dị ọnụ ala karịa.
l-m-e6-b05-32.s.s1.explain: Iji kpuchie mpaghara 28.26 m², ịchọrọ 32 m²; ùkwù 2 (won 10000) bụ nke dị ọnụ ala karịa.
l-m-e6-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: Mpaghara ahụ bụ 3×3×3.14=28.26 m²; n'ime atụmatụ abụọ na-ekpuchi 32 m², nke dị ọnụ ala karịa, ùkwù 2 (won 10000), bụ nhọrọ ziri ezi.

l-m-e6-b05-40.material: A na-ahọrọ onye nnọchi anya site na akara n'ihe ọmụmụ atọ. Nkezi ga-abụ opekata mpe akara 80, ọ nweghịkwa ihe ọmụmụ ga-adị ala karịa 70; n'ime ndị mezuru ọnọdụ ndị a, họrọ onye nwere nkezi kacha elu.

l-m-e6-b05-40.s.s1.r.b: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma nkezi ya dị ala karịa nke D.
l-m-e6-b05-40.s.s1.r.c: Nkezi ya dị ihe dị ka akara 78.3, nke na-erughị akara 80.
l-m-e6-b05-40.s.s1.explain: N'ime B (akara 80) na D (ihe dị ka akara 80.3), ndị mezuru ọnọdụ niile, D nwere nkezi ka elu.
